entities.title: High-score Worker
entities.summary: The Cloudflare Worker: the signed-in game page, the high-score API and the public scores page.
entities.purpose: Serves the game behind icelander.net's sign-in, issues seeds, replays submitted games with the engine, and keeps the table in D1 (schema.sql).
boundaries: Static files other than the page are served by Cloudflare's assets, not by this code.
Online games never reach it: the games hub relays them.
The sign-in is checked with vendor/icelander-auth, which is icelander.net's and never edited here.
